generate_story_with_inference_qa: create a World instance and generate a story with observations and inference questions mixed in
try_generate_observation: generate a single random observation edge in the toy story world graph with inference rules applied
generate_question_from_graph: generate a question-answer pair from existing edges in the world graph with optional support filtering
edge_to_question_dict: convert a graph edge into a question dictionary with answer, supports, and sub-questions
generate_unknown_question: generate an intentionally unanswerable question about a relation that does not exist in the world graph
